ProductJournalEntry.description: One persisted fulfillment journal row, as `rocky product journal` prints it: the loop's own record of a transition, field for field.

at.description: RFC 3339 instant of the transition, when recorded.

event.description: What happened, in the loop's plain language (`spec approved`, …). A label to render, not an enum to switch on.

from_state.description: The state tag before the transition, when one existed.

idempotency_key.description: The idempotency key pinned by this event, when it pinned one.

plan_id.description: The plan involved, when the event concerns one (propose, apply).

seq.description: Sequence number, also encoded in the row's store key.

spec_digest.description: The spec digest involved, when the event concerns one.

to_state.description: The state tag after the transition.

description:
JSON output of `rocky product journal <name>`.

The product's fulfillment journal, whole and in append order, read through the same store function the fulfillment loop reads through. A known product with no rows is an empty journal; a product the project does not know (no spec file, no store record) is a refusal, never an empty journal.

count.description: `rows.len()`, repeated so a consumer can assert it received the whole journal.

product_id.description: `product:<name>`, the store key every record of the product hangs off.

rows.description: Every journal row, in append order.

title: ProductJournalOutput
